# Template: tornado_diagram
A tornado diagram for one-way sensitivity analysis: horizontal bars, one per uncertain parameter, showing how far the result swings when that parameter moves from its low to its high value, sorted widest on top (the tornado shape), split in two colors at the dashed base-case line. Choose this scene for ANY request about tornado diagrams, one-way or univariate sensitivity analysis, which parameter drives the result, or the robustness of a cost-effectiveness or business-case result.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "bars": {
   "type": "array",
   "minItems": 2,
   "maxItems": 8,
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Parameter name — keep under ~22 characters."
     },
     "low": {
      "type": "number"
     },
     "high": {
      "type": "number"
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "label",
     "low",
     "high"
    ]
   },
   "description": "One entry per parameter; sorted by swing automatically. Default: a five-parameter cost-effectiveness example."
  },
  "base": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Base-case result where the bars pivot (default 0)."
  },
  "x_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Default \"Net monetary benefit\"."
  },
  "show_values": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Print the low/high values at the bar ends (default false)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the horizontal result axis (a group with caption)
- base_line: dashed vertical base-case line with its caption
- bar_<i>: the i-th widest bar (two colored halves + outline, a group)
- bar_label_<i>: its parameter name on the left
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a tornado diagram for a cost-effectiveness analysis." → params: {"title":"What drives the result?"}
Request: "Tornado diagram: effectiveness swings the result from -50 to 60, price from -35 to 30, adherence from -20 to 15." → params: {"bars":[{"label":"Effectiveness","low":-50,"high":60},{"label":"Price","low":-35,"high":30},{"label":"Adherence","low":-20,"high":15}],"show_values":true,"title":"Three uncertainties"}

In YAML: `template: tornado_diagram` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
